blocks.title: Research ethics
blocks.text: Research ethics woh usool hain jin par researchers chalte hain ta ke kaam diyanatdar, ba-izzat aur munsifana rahe, research ki diyanat aur shurakaa, research community aur muashre ke huqooq aur behbood mehfooz rahein.
Agar aap hum jamaaton se social media ke parhai par asar ka survey karein to ethics ka taqaza hai ke zaati maloomat jama karne se pehle ijazat lein aur un ke jawab raaz rakhein.

blocks.prompt: Hum jamaaton ke survey mein do akhlaqi faraiz bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Pehle soch samajh kar ijazat lein, aur un ke jawab raaz rakhein.

items: Research ethics: diyanatdar, ba-izzat, munsifana research jo shurakaa ko bachaye.
